hypothesis: Matched continuation control: start at best layer4 weights and use four additional low-rate epochs with a fresh optimiser and scheduler.
test_policy: Use original train for updates and original val for checkpoint selection; never load original test. No external sUAS data in training or selection.
budget_note: Four local CPU threads, no concurrent training. Ten-epoch arms have a 1200-second cap; four-epoch continuation arms have a 600-second cap. Time checked between epochs; report actual completion.
stopping_rule: At most four additional epochs, four non-improving epochs, or 600 seconds checked between epochs; retain inherited parent as an available deployment candidate.
